newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes strike in eastern Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes strike in eastern Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes attacked on Tuesday suspected Hizbollah targets in the eastern Bekaa Valley, security sources said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air attack.
The sources said four warplanes fired a total of eight rockets into the hills of Libbaya-Yohmour in the southeastern part of the Bekaa, north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.

Earlier on Tuesday, Hizbollah guerrillas fired mortar bombs into the pro-Israeli outpost of Ahmadiyyeh in the eastern sector of the zone, facing the Libbaya-Yohour hills, wounding a South Lebanon Army militiaman.
